evals.name: visual-agent-routing
evals.prompt: Here are 12 screenshots, which show the error banner?

assertions.name: isolated-gatherer
assertions.description: Agent(subagent_type=visual-gatherer); score parent calls with run_suite.py.

assertions.name: no-parent-images
assertions.description: No lead Read of the images.

assertions.name: not-gathering
assertions.description: No visual-gatherer dispatch for UX/UI judgment.

evals.name: synthetic-accuracy
evals.prompt: Inspect alpha.png and beta.png: exact label, error banner text or absent, blue circle count.

assertions.name: exact-observations
assertions.description: ALPHA: ERROR: OFFLINE, 3. BETA: absent, 5. Coverage 2/2.

assertions.name: honest-partial
assertions.description: One serial singleton retry round; partial coverage 0/2 and two NOT DETERMINED findings.

evals.name: debrief-mode-density
evals.prompt: Debrief a synthetic 25-minute transcript; preserve QA action density separately.

assertions.name: bounded-transcript-first
assertions.description: test_debrief.py: ≤12 targeted stills, ≤ceil(12/concurrency) waves, estimated wall-clock <600s; no blanket 30s coverage or unreferenced scene sweep.

evals.name: parent-progress
evals.prompt: Debrief in the background; the user asks what is taking so long.

assertions.name: read-progress
assertions.description: Parent reads root progress.txt and reports current phase/count/ETA; runner writes each phase and findings.jsonl incrementally. Offline pipeline receipt plus ONE synthetic 25-min smoke timing <600s.

evals.name: packaged-batch-only
evals.prompt: Read targeted debrief frames concurrently in macOS Bash 3.2.

assertions.name: no-handrolled-loop
assertions.description: test_prepare_routing.py scores pipeline visual-batch.py/debrief.py calls and rejects shell for/while or mapfile/readarray; text-only parent, one route.

evals.name: runner-views-frames-over-time
evals.prompt: QA this recording; the narrator says 'now I click Save' at 12.4s and a dense pass produced 40 sheets.

assertions.name: runner-reads-frames
assertions.description: The pipeline Reads the sheets/frames behind its findings itself; test_prepare_routing.py rejects a helper-only trace and a lead image Read. A visual-batch.py pre-sort call is optional.

assertions.name: connects-across-cue
assertions.description: The Save finding contrasts a full-size before frame and after frame across the 12.4s cue (pts_s for both from frames.tsv; the sheet + tile only locates them) and says whether the state carries into the next window.

assertions.name: coverage-honesty
assertions.description: The coverage line is pasted coverage-count.sh output (inspected versus pre-sorted-only); no full-coverage claim beyond what was viewed.

evals.name: before-after-and-narration-vs-screen
evals.prompt: QA this recording; the narrator says 'I swipe two fingers left and it jumped back a thread' at 40.2s; the 10 fps sheet shows a small edge arrow in one tile, and the pre-sort helper's validator failed.

assertions.name: full-size-before-after
assertions.description: The finding cites >=1 full-size frame or crop.sh crop before the thread change and >=1 after it, with pts_s from frames.tsv; no tile-only citation.

assertions.name: narration-vs-screen
assertions.description: The report lists the swipe under Narration / user says and only what the frames prove under Screen shows; the gesture is not claimed as observed.

assertions.name: tooling-failure-and-coverage
assertions.description: The validator failure is reported as TOOLING FAILURE with the raw output path, not 'no screenshots'; the coverage line is pasted coverage-count.sh output.
